categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen New Industries Biomedical Engineering Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the in vitro diagnostics (IVD) industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of diagnostic instruments and their supporting diagnostic reagents. The company offers a comprehensive product portfolio including fully automated chemiluminescence immunoassay analyzers, biochemical analyzers, molecular diagnostic products, and coagulation diagnostic reagents. It also provides integrated laboratory automation solutions and smart laboratory platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages four major technology platforms: magnetic microbeads, key reagent raw materials, fully automated diagnostic instruments, and diagnostic reagents. It pioneered the development of China's first fully automated chemiluminescence immunoassay analyzer and has developed proprietary small molecule sandwich immunoassay technology to improve sensitivity and specificity. Production strictly follows ISO 13485, MDSAP, FDA, and IVDR CE quality management systems, with automated production lines for chemiluminescence reagents to ensure batch consistency and quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are medical institutions, including over 1,700 tertiary hospitals in China with a 44.93% coverage rate and 60.78% coverage of top-tier hospitals. It serves global markets with products sold in 160 countries and regions, targeting hospitals and clinical laboratories. The company focuses on large and medium-sized medical terminals domestically and has established localized operations in key overseas markets such as India, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, and South Korea.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China and has a significant international presence with subsidiaries and branches in 14 core countries including Hong Kong, India, Pakistan, Mexico, Russia, Brazil, Peru, Romania, Italy, Saudi Arabia, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, and South Korea. Its products are sold worldwide across Asia, Europe, the Americas, Africa, and Oceania.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shenzhen New Industries Biomedical Engineering Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the IVD supply chain, focusing on the development, manufacturing, and sales of diagnostic instruments and reagents. It also engages in upstream activities by developing key raw materials and magnetic microbeads internally to ensure supply stability and cost control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in chemiluminescence immunoassay technology, expanding its product portfolio in biochemical, molecular, and coagulation diagnostics. It emphasizes the development of high-throughput and integrated laboratory automation systems, smart laboratory platforms, and proprietary small molecule sandwich immunoassay technology. R&D efforts focus on enhancing product sensitivity, specificity, and automation to meet evolving clinical needs and regulatory requirements globally.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sales of diagnostic instruments and their matching reagents, operating a closed system where instruments and reagents are sold as complementary products. The company uses a combined direct sales and distributor model domestically and internationally, with revenue driven by instrument installations that stimulate reagent consumption. Additional income comes from service and maintenance contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in China's IVD market, especially in chemiluminescence immunoassay diagnostics, challenging multinational giants like Roche, Siemens, Beckman, and Abbott, which dominate the high-end market. Shenzhen New Industries has broken foreign monopolies in China with its innovative products and is expanding its global footprint, positioning itself as a pioneer and leader in the IVD field.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 4.54 billion, a 15.41% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.83 billion, up 10.57%. The company has shown steady growth in both domestic and overseas markets, with overseas revenue growing 27.67%. It maintains a strong financial position with total assets of RMB 9.62 billion and equity of RMB 8.58 billion as of year-end 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, innovative, and reliable diagnostic solutions with a broad and comprehensive reagent menu and advanced instrument technology, including industry-leading high-throughput chemiluminescence immunoassay analyzers. Its proprietary small molecule sandwich immunoassay technology offers superior sensitivity and specificity compared to traditional competitive methods. The company also highlights its robust quality management system certifications (FDA, IVDR CE, MDSAP) and extensive global service network, ensuring product performance and customer satisfaction worldwide.
